content: Avengers Doomsday World Tour Countdown! Also, how will VisionQuest End? Welcome back to the New Rockstars Podcast! This week, Erik Voss and Jessica Clemons talk about the unusual marketing and commercial tie-ins for Avengers Doomsday in these final weeks, the casting of Ben Wang as Bobby Drake Iceman in X-Men, VisionQuest’s final trailer and how the finale episode will go down, and big details revealed for The Batman Part 2!
